hypothesis: At the frozen champion micro-recipe (s16 · lr=1e-3 · bs=2 · structural_bias=1.5 · seed=47 · ASAP · t30 · scratch/cpu), the smoke suite's meaningful_program_rate=0.333 (n=3) reflects real headroom that persists or improves on a larger held-out suite, rather than n=3 sampling noise.
confound: held_out differs from smoke in BOTH suite domain and n (5 vs 3) -- this is a suite-generalization check, not a pure n ablation. No isolated same-domain n=3-vs-n>3 suite exists in this fixture build.
decision_reason: meaningful_program_rate collapses 0.333 (smoke n=3) -> 0.0 (held_out n=5) on the identical checkpoint; placeholder_fidelity (0.528->0.29) and structural_similarity (0.254->0.098) both drop substantially too, while parse_rate holds at 1.0 on both. The smoke n=3 meaningful-program result does not generalize to a different, still-tiny held-out suite. This reinforces honest-ship-eval's fixture-demo-vs-ship distinction and must not be read as new headroom to chase via more micro-recipe tuning.
